title: Rank hospital-acquired infections by their burden — rank_infections
text: data data frame shaped like hai_burden, columns country, infection, measure, scale, median, lower upper. measure measure burden: "Cases", "Deaths" "DALYs". Defaults "DALYs" combines deaths illness one measure harm. country "Germany" "Europe". scale "Total" whole-population numbers, "Per 100,000 people" compare countries different sizes. infections Optional character vector infections include. NULL (default) keeps five.

title: Rank hospital-acquired infections by their burden — rank_infections
text: tibble one row per infection, ordered largest smallest burden: rank 1 = largest burden. infection Infection type. median, lower, upper Best estimate 95% uncertainty interval. share Percentage total burden selected infections. infections empty, tibble zero rows returned.
